lines.text: This is the story of Nico the snail.
lines.how: Say it as a warm storyteller telling a story to young learners, with expression.

lines.text: Nico the snail is a lovely brown snail, but he is very sad.
lines.how: Say it as a warm storyteller telling a story to young learners, with expression.

lines.text: Slow is horrible.
lines.how: Say it as a small, sad, slow, gentle character, a little whiny; the excited parts brighter, the last lines happy.

lines.text: Hello, Nico. Why are you sad?
lines.how: Say it as a bright, quick, chirpy bird.

lines.text: Slow is horrible. I want to be quick like you.
lines.how: Say it as a small, sad, slow, gentle character, a little whiny; the excited parts brighter, the last lines happy.

lines.text: Go and see the wizard at the top of the hill. He can change the way you move.
lines.how: Say it as a bright, quick, chirpy bird.

lines.text: That's a good idea. Goodbye.
lines.how: Say it as a small, sad, slow, gentle character, a little whiny; the excited parts brighter, the last lines happy.

lines.text: Goodbye.
lines.how: Say it as a bright, quick, chirpy bird.

lines.text: Nico the snail climbs to the top of the hill.
lines.how: Say it as a warm storyteller telling a story to young learners, with expression.

lines.text: Slow is horrible. I want to be quick like the bird or the rabbit.
lines.how: Say it as a small, sad, slow, gentle character, a little whiny; the excited parts brighter, the last lines happy.

lines.text: Ha, ha, ha! No problem. I can make you quick. Are you ready?
lines.how: Say it as a grand, jolly wizard, theatrical, with a big laugh.

lines.text: One, two, three. Presto!
lines.how: Say it as a grand, jolly wizard, theatrical, with a big laugh.

lines.text: Whoosh, bang!
lines.how: Say it as a warm storyteller telling a story to young learners, with expression.

lines.text: Now I'm like the bird… Oh, no… I'm too high! It's horrible!
lines.how: Say it as a small, sad, slow, gentle character, a little whiny; the excited parts brighter, the last lines happy.

lines.text: Let's try again. One, two, three. Presto!
lines.how: Say it as a grand, jolly wizard, theatrical, with a big laugh.

lines.text: Now I'm like the rabbit… Oh, no… I can't stop! It's horrible! Oh, please, I want to be a snail! I want to be brown! I want to be ME!
lines.how: Say it as a small, sad, slow, gentle character, a little whiny; the excited parts brighter, the last lines happy.

lines.text: OK, Nico. But this is the last time. One, two, three. Presto!
lines.how: Say it as a grand, jolly wizard, theatrical, with a big laugh.

lines.text: Are you happy now?
lines.how: Say it as a grand, jolly wizard, theatrical, with a big laugh.

lines.text: Oh, yes. I'm happy now. I'm a lovely brown snail! Thank you. Goodbye.
lines.how: Say it as a small, sad, slow, gentle character, a little whiny; the excited parts brighter, the last lines happy.

lines.text: You raise your left hand up,

lines.text: Up, down, up, down, you wave it all around

lines.text: You do the Wave and Turn,
lines.how: This is a line of a chant: say it rhythmically, on a strong steady beat, bright and clipped.

lines.text: And you spin around.

lines.text: That's what it's all about!
